title: Product photos as one batch
description: Line up the background and the sizes, check the difficult outlines and get a finished batch of files.

blocks.text: A seller needs several products presented the same way, with their real details kept. After one piece of jewelry has been edited successfully, a different job begins: repeat the settings and find the frames where the automatic cutout went wrong.

quote.text: This is my go to app for removing backgrounds, editing and making my jewelry pop like a star ⭐️! Hopefully, they will not get rid of my new best friend. I simply love this app! I will admit, I have not tried everything this app has to offer ( it’s a lot), but what I tried, I was happy with the outcome.

blocks.text: Carrying the edit through to a result

A small trial group is processed first. The common background, margins and size are applied to the whole series; an individual frame can be fixed without resetting the rest. Before saving, the exceptions and the file settings are visible.
Where the idea has an advantage

The main criterion is how many images can be used after the check, not the speed of the first background removal. A standalone product is justified by a noticeable reduction in rework in the chosen product scenario.
